description: This file contains utility functions for fetching weather data, including configuration retrieval, and weather data fetching with fallback mechanisms. It interacts with environment variables and external APIs like OpenWeatherMap and a backend server.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Determines the API base URL from environment variables, trimming trailing slashes or returning null if not set.

methods.name: getOWMApiKey()
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenWeatherMap API key from environment variables, returning null if absent.

methods.name: fetchWeather(city)
methods.description: Fetches current weather data for a specified city, using a configured backend URL if available, otherwise falling back to OpenWeatherMap API, with error handling.
